searches.reason: Develop controlled probes for NextItNet’s use of recent intent: compare score changes after removing recent repeats, deleting isolated old events, or shuffling history within fixed windows. Include causal-padding and final-nonpadding readout checks. Seek interventions that distinguish useful temporal dependence from sequence-length artifacts and connect failures to dilation, receptive field, and training loss.

searches.reason: Translate qualitative complaints into measurable recommendation audits using available titles, descriptions, histories, and actual feedback. Investigate annotation rubrics for specific recent-purpose matches, duplicates versus complements, and explicitly stated compatibility; retain unknown labels when evidence is insufficient. Seek practical ways to validate text-based proxies against human judgments without inferring purchases satisfied a need or inventing user traits.
searches.query: recommendation explanation diagnostic audit user feedback intent mismatch duplicate complementary products compatibility uncertainty annotation title description human agreement 2023 2026

searches.reason: Establish whether diagnostic signals reliably identify ranking failures and useful model changes. Seek user-level bootstrap uncertainty, controlled failure injection, and agreement checks between sampled pairwise margins and full-catalog unseen-item rankings. Use training-only held-out prefixes for probe development, preserve the host validation protocol, report missing measurements explicitly, and assess each category before macro aggregation.
